content.thinking: `du` isn't available. Let me use Python to compute the size and entries. And confirm the tests still pass after the census edits (run cases + fuzz).

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && rm -rf submission/__pycache__ && python3 -c "
import os
total=0; entries=0
for root,dirs,files in os.walk('submission'):
    for name in dirs+files:
        entries+=1
        p=os.path.join(root,name)
        if os.path.islink(p): print('SYMLINK',p)
        total+=os.path.getsize(p)
print('entries',entries,'bytes',total)
print(sorted(os.listdir('submission')))
" && timeout 1200 python3 tools/cases.py 2>&1 | tail -2 && timeout 1800 python3 tools/fuzz.py 60 2>&1 | tail -2
